# Vercel: get edge config token meta data

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

Vercel edge config tokens allow scoped access to configuration data at the edge. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact API endpoint path for token metadata retrieval. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact HTTP method and required headers. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact response shape and status codes for successful/failed requests. Agents should validate token ownership and scope before using tokens in deployments.

Search intents:
- Vercel edge config token metadata
- Vercel API token management
- Vercel deploy config access

Validation command: python3 scripts/agentpress.py material-kit-validate agentpress/material-kits/vercel-edge-config-token-meta-data --json
